results.title: World Cup Socceroo snapped up by German club
results.description: Melbourne Victory's Nishan Velupillay has become the latest World Cup Socceroo to be snapped up by a European club, moving to the German third division.

results.title: Mashburn deal collapses as Roca Team turns to new Andorran-backed rescue plan
results.description: The Roca Team’s rescue effort has taken a dramatic new turn, according to Monaco-Matin, with former NBA player Jamal Mashburn failing to deliver the funds he had promised, just a day ahead of the club’s scheduled hearing before the CNOSF.
